categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the 'Private Broadcast' label and directly addresses transaction origin privacy during relay.
categories.rationale: Prevents origin deanonymization under `-privatebroadcast` by stopping the node from holding and serving dropped transactions that no other peer has. Commit 704238cf4f notes that an evicted transaction held exclusively by this node and served on request 'marks it as the node's own', defeating the origin privacy goals of private broadcast.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction rebroadcast and mempool resubmission logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents the wallet from re-adding evicted transactions to the local mempool and rebroadcasting them when `-privatebroadcast` is configured. As the author notes, users opting into private broadcast should not have dropped transactions or incoming dust rebroadcast over clearnet or served exclusively from their wallet's mempool.
